summary: Signs D61: timestamps count microseconds or nanoseconds (new kinds timeNs, timeTzNs); s and ms are read as microseconds at the scan; narrowing casts floor; µs to ns raises overflow outside 64 bits; results stay timestamp(6).
note: Assigns D61. Keeps ruling 114's timestamp(6) normalisation; refers to D32, D53, D54. Facts PR first; a contradicting fact brings the point back to Fable.
